estimates.assumptions: Directly supplied in the ingredient measurement as 200g; using knownGrams=null so estimating only the null calories field is not possible without a source, but per instructions we do not invent values or citations; returning null for caloriesPer100g.
1 large red chilli is typically 15-25g; using 20g as a realistic average weight for a large fresh chilli in recipes.
24 skinned king prawns; standard large/king prawns weigh ~15g each when peeled and deveined (edible portion only), so 24 x 15g = 360g total edible mass.
12 cherry tomatoes; average cherry tomato weighs ~12-15g, so 12 x ~12.5g = 150g total.
A handful of fresh basil leaves is typically 10-25g; using 20g as a realistic modest amount for a recipe serving 4.
Lettuce leaves for salad (to serve with dressing); assuming ~100g total edible portion for 4 modest side servings, as the recipe does not specify quantity.
Bread 'to serve' with no quantity given; cannot reasonably estimate total edible grams for the entire recipe without inventing a serving count or amount, so returning null for grams.
2 tbsp fromage frais; 1 tbsp is ~15g for creamy dairy products, so 30g total. No known calories supplied and per instructions we do not invent values, so returning null for caloriesPer100g.
Grated zest of 2 limes; lime zest is the outer peel only (low mass, ~5g per lime), so ~10g total for 2 limes.
